literal_meaning: রাগে জ্বলা আগুন (burning fire in anger)
figurative_meaning_en: extremely angry or burning with rage
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ভাইয়ের কথায় রেগে আগুন হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He was burning with anger at his brother's words.
The spectators were furious with the match decision.
note: The idiom vividly uses fire imagery common in Bengali expressions for intense emotions.
